summary: Iteration 28 — Anti-bloqueio + presence/message-status webhooks + long-campaign async runner. Backend pytest: 16/16 PASSED on iteration 28 + 19/19 regression on iteration 27 = 35/35 (100%). Validated: (1) POST/PUT /api/crm/campaigns persist and update anti_block (defaults: enabled=true, 30/90s, burst=50, pause=300s, daily=250, hourly=50, escalate_after=100, factor=1.5, only_with_phone_validated=true; custom values respected). (2) POST /api/channels/webhook/presence persists doc in contact_presence and GET /api/channels/contact-presence returns it (60s window); unknown instance_id => {ok:false} (no 500). (3) POST /api/channels/webhook/message-status returns {ok:true} with non-existent message_id (NO 500), {ok:false} when message_id/status missing. (4) POST /api/crm/campaigns/{id}/run with 200 contacts + default anti_block (~12000s estimated) returned in <5s with {queued:true, audience:200, estimated_minutes>=1} and DB status='em_execucao'. Sync path with 2 contacts and zero intervals returns {sent,failed,total} synchronously. (5) Iteration 27 regressions all green: queues CRUD, contact-lists CRUD, kanban-v2 totals_by_column, ticket tags add/remove, webhook connected/message filtering, retry, wa-contacts/import-contacts graceful 502 when WA microservice offline, ticket update queue_id/connection_id.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_routes.py run_campaign async _runner: opens its own Mongo client via os.environ['MONGO_URL'] and DB_NAME — works, but never closes the client (small connection leak when many long campaigns run). Consider 'async with AsyncIOMotorClient(...)' or sharing the global db handle.

crm_routes.py run_campaign async _runner: bdb is referenced inside the except handler but only assigned earlier in the try; if the AsyncIOMotorClient instantiation itself fails, 'bdb' will be undefined and the except will UnboundLocalError. Wrap the failure-update path with its own try.

crm_routes.py run_campaign sync path: applies anti_block delays (interval_min/max) inline — for audiences slightly under 5min threshold the request still blocks for up to several minutes. The 300s threshold is hardcoded; consider making it configurable.

channels_routes.py webhook_presence/webhook_message_status: no auth/secret header — any external caller can write to contact_presence and update tickets messages. Acceptable for an internal microservice but should validate a shared secret before prod.
channels_routes.py contact-presence GET: cutoff is computed via isoformat() string compare; works because UTC ISO strings sort lexicographically when zone is consistent. Worth a comment.
models.py CampaignAntiBlock: should validate interval_min <= interval_max and positive ints via pydantic validators (currently coerced in run endpoint with max() — fine but better at model level).
iteration 27 unresolved (not regression for 28): scheduling_routes.create_client does not persist 'tags'.
